replacement_or_supplementary_sources.what_it_supports: Munich Re 2025: India 63%, Indonesia 14%, China 11%, Bangladesh 3%, Vietnam 3% of Asia cargo theft incidents; facility theft 34%; insider involvement >25%. Figures consistently quoted verbatim across MHL News, Air Cargo Week, and other independent trade-press.

Independent cross-validation: India, Indonesia, China, Bangladesh, Vietnam named as Asia's most-affected. ~50% facility theft in Asia (vs Munich Re 34% — different dataset). Insider involvement 22% of Asia regional thefts. Indonesia named alongside India and China as high-insider-involvement market. Indonesia = 5% of global incidents (different denominator).

revised_claim_text: Indonesia accounts for ~14% of Asia cargo theft incidents per Munich Re Cargo Theft Tactics and Trends 2025 (India 63%, China 11%). Facility-based incidents account for ~34% of Asia incidents per Munich Re; the TT Club / BSI 2025 Report (April 2026) independently confirms India, Indonesia, and China as Asia's top three most-affected countries and puts facility theft closer to ~50% under different incident classification. Insider involvement: Munich Re >25% of Asia thefts; TT Club/BSI 22% — directionally consistent. Munich Re page returns HTTP 403; figures corroborated via independent trade press summaries.
